items.item: trial_end events carry at_ms 0.0
items.evidence: In all 32 trials the last event (kind trial_end, empty payload) has at_ms exactly 0.0, so at_ms goes backwards at the agent_result -> trial_end step (32 non-monotonic steps, all of that one kind). items.item: 9. Anything not done as registered (warm-up, command, environment, versions, model id, one worker)
items.evidence: Nothing found that departs from the registration. Warm-up: the wrapper sent one prompt through the CLI, 'ollama run qwen3.5:4b-mlx-ctx32k "Reply with the single word ok."'; the log (lines 52 to 69) shows a thinking block and the answer 'ok', then 'run start'. It is one stateless request with no tools, no system prompt of the study and no task text; the trials send their full message list each time with reasoning off (agent.py), so the wrapper and agent code give no path for it to reach a trial's input. It ran before both arms; the first trial took 5.1 s, inside the 3.5 to 6.2 s range of the others. What the server keeps in memory between requests cannot be read from the files. The warm-up used the CLI's thinking mode; the registration fixed that a call is made, the digest-bound wrapper fixed its text. Command: wrapper line 176 runs 'caffeinate -dims $PYTHON -m arci run <folder>/arci.yaml --workers 1 --out <study>/runs-run-3', the registered command with absolute paths; the log does not echo the command line. One worker: besides the flag, trial wall times sum to 122.4 s in a 123 s window, and trials are stored strictly baseline then candidate per pair. Environment: logged variables are the three ARCI_QUICKSTART values (both ids ollama:qwen3.5:4b-mlx-ctx32k, temperature 0.7), both tracing switches false and the audit path; no OLLAMA_ or PYTHONPATH variable. Versions in the log: agent-reliability-ci 2.4.0, langchain 1.4.10, langchain-core 1.7.7, langgraph 1.2.20, langgraph-prebuilt 1.1.1, langchain-ollama 1.1.0, ollama 0.6.3, pydantic 2.14.3, Python 3.13.12, Ollama 0.32.14; the same dist-info folders are in the environment now, and all 85 files of the installed arci match its RECORD hashes (installer pip, no direct_url.json, so an index install; which index is not provable). Model: listed id c01efed5a364 before, 'ollama ps after' shows the same id, context 32768, 100% GPU. Manifest stores temperature 0.7 and reasoning false for both arms in every task. Machine now reports Apple M5 Pro, 24 GiB; AC power in the log. Three notes, none a breach: (a) a 'check' run at 16:10:08Z preceded the real start (run-3-check.log, committed); it calls no model and the keep-alive timer shows it did not touch the model; (b) the Ollama server version is logged but not enforced by the wrapper; (c) the environment sits in a /private/tmp scratchpad folder that a reboot can clear.
items.fix: None required. Optional: one sentence in the result that the warm-up prompt was 'Reply with the single word ok.' sent with the CLI's default thinking mode, and that a guard-only check run preceded the start.

items.item: 10. Smoke run: before registration, other suite id, registered files unchanged after it
items.evidence: Confirmed parts: run-3-smoke.log says 'mode: smoke', 'start: 2026-11-16T16:04:08Z', 'run end: 2026-11-16T16:05:14Z', 'records commit: af0b52f...' (the parent of the registration commit); the registration commit is 16:09:59Z, so the smoke run ended 4 min 45 s before it. Its store is order-desk-qwen3.5-4b-empty-lookup-text-smoke-not-evidence@857e1cc1... with alpha 1/2, delta 1/2, one round; 16 trials all completed, baseline 6/8, candidate 3/8, errored 0, 8 audit lines with 8 distinct ids, first trial 4.4 s, longest 6.2 s, 65 s in all: every smoke figure in the pre-registration matches. Smoke and real manifests have identical tasks, conditions, budgets and arm definitions; no seed is shared. The smoke log and smoke audit file are unchanged since c217ae6. Not supported: the pre-registration's sentence 'The registered files are the files the smoke run used. Nothing was changed after it.' is false for one of the 17 registered files, the wrapper run-3.sh. Its modification time is 21:39:45 IST, after the smoke run ended (21:35:14) and 14 s before the commit. The smoke log also lacks two lines the registered wrapper writes in every mode ('model id as listed: ...' and 'preflight: arci module ...'), and no run-3-smoke.started marker exists although the registered wrapper would create one and never remove it. So the smoke run used an earlier wrapper; the marker, the model-id check and the arci-module check were added afterwards (review R7 in the same commit asks for exactly these). For the other 16 files, modification times run from 21:06:05 to 21:33:58, all before the smoke start at 21:34:08, which is consistent with 'unchanged' but is weak evidence. Cannot be established: git has no smoke-time state (all registered files were first committed in c217ae6, after the smoke run, and smoke mode checks no digest), and nothing of the Python code is sealed in either store. The smoke store folder runs-run-3-smoke/ is untracked, so the smoke counts cited in the pre-registration are not reproducible from the published branch. The trial path of the wrapper (working folder, the five exported variables, the arci command) is the same in both logs; the real-mode guards and the warm-up were not exercised by the smoke run.

The registered digest is of the changed wrapper, which is the one that ran. For the other 16 registered files only their modification times, all before the smoke run, support that they were unchanged; git cannot show it.' What the run gives is a statistical BLOCK: the test rejected "gain 10 points or less"; the qualifier only arrives in the next sentence. "raised" also sits oddly beside the bullet "Nothing about ... cause" a few lines below. Temperature 0.7 and the one wording are part of the scope and are not named.

items.item: L96-99: "Under the rule's assumptions, the chance of this verdict when the true gain is 10 points or less is at most 2.5%; ARCI does not check those assumptions, and with per-round seeds the bound needs the null to hold in every round's scenario instances."
items.evidence: Mostly what STATISTICS_SUITE.md guarantees: P(ever BLOCK-crossed | Delta >= -delta, manifest) <= alpha/2 = 2.5%; with the roles swapped Delta >= -1/10 is "gain <= 10 points" (equality included, as written); the bound covers a statistical BLOCK only, which line 36 establishes; and the contract's rule that a per_round guarantee carries the per-round condition in the same sentence is met. Three weak points. (1) "the true gain" presupposes one gain; in per_round mode the contract speaks of each round's suite mean over that round's scenario instances, and a gain averaged over seeds of 10 points or less does not give the bound. The last clause repairs this only if the reader connects the two. (2) "the null to hold in every round's scenario instances" drops "the suite mean over". (3) The contract and the registration both add "there is no guarantee averaged over seeds"; it is missing here. The assumptions are also not named (independent cells and rounds, same law each round, no arm-order effect).
items.fix: Under the rule's assumptions (independent cells and rounds, the same law in every round, no effect of which arm runs first), the chance of a statistical BLOCK is at most 2.5% if, in every round, the mean gain over that round's scenario instances on these 8 cells is 10 points or less; ARCI does not check those assumptions, and there is no guarantee averaged over seeds.
